title: From objective discovery to prediction of global ocean eco-provinces: A pathway for trustworthy learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.13206v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Marine ecosystems are increasingly impacted by climate change, necessitating tools to identify and predict spatial habitat information. To build such tools, ecological marine provinces, "eco-provinces", ecologically meaningful regions in the global ocean can be used. We use unsupervised machine learning (ML) to identify eco-provinces with corresponding uncertainty measures based on output of a global simulation of phytoplankton functional types. Our work aims to create a proof of concept to predict eco-provinces based on satellite ocean color data. To do so, we develop a hierarchy of explainable dense ensemble networks to infer how well the eco-provinces can be detected from modeled ocean color fields. Key results include that the delineated eco-provinces are both ecologically meaningful and can be inferred with high skill. translated_title: 从客观发现到全球海洋生态省的预测：一条通往可信赖学习的路径
translated_abstract: 海洋生态系统日益受到气候变化的影响，因此需要能够识别和预测空间栖息地信息的工具。为了构建此类工具，可以利用生态海洋省（"eco-provinces"），即全球海洋中具有生态学意义的区域。我们基于浮游植物功能类型全球模拟的输出，使用无监督机器学习（ML）来识别生态省及其相应的不确定性度量。我们的工作旨在创建一个概念验证，即基于卫星海洋水色数据来预测生态省。为此，我们开发了一系列可解释的密集集成网络，以推断从模拟的海洋水色场中能够以何种程度检测出生态省。关键结果表明，所划定的生态省既具有生态学意义，又能以高精度被推断出来。然而，研究并未发现向网络添加更多输入数据能够持续改善结果……
tldr: 该研究提出了一条可信赖的机器学习路径：利用无监督学习从全球浮游植物功能类型模拟中识别出带有不确定性度量的海洋生态省，并通过可解释的密集集成网络实现了基于卫星海洋水色数据对生态省的高精度预测。
en_tdlr: This study presents a trustworthy machine learning pathway that identifies ocean eco-provinces with uncertainty measures via unsupervised learning from global phytoplankton functional type simulations, and achieves high-skill prediction of eco-provinces from satellite ocean color data using a hierarchy of explainable dense ensemble networks.
